facts.text: Q2 FY27 results: **Reliance Industries** profit up 41% to **₹25,548 crore** (Jio revenue ₹47,485 crore); **IOC** profit more than doubled to ₹21,630 crore (GRM $18.52/bbl); **GAIL** profit ₹4,650 crore (GAIL Gas IPO planned in FY28); **IGL** profit fell 93%; **Sun Pharma** fell 36.4% on Organon acquisition charges.
